edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against _OWNER_ before allowing transferOwnership.
claimOwnership requires msg.sender == _NEW_OWNER_, so caller identity gates ownership takeover.
Privileged template/duration/rate mutations are gated solely by msg.sender through onlyOwner.
_OWNER_ is read in the onlyOwner check of transferOwnership.
_NEW_OWNER_ is read to authorize the claimOwnership caller.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into _NEW_OWNER_.
transferOwnership reads _OWNER_ to emit OwnershipTransferPrepared.
claimOwnership overwrites _OWNER_ with _NEW_OWNER_.
claimOwnership clears _NEW_OWNER_ to address(0).
initOwner assigns the initial owner to _OWNER_.
initOwner sets _INITIALIZED_ to true.
notInitialized modifier reads _INITIALIZED_ to prevent repeated initialization.
cpAddress is the caller-supplied target of the external init call.
valueList is forwarded to the external ICP.init call.
timeLine is forwarded to the external ICP.init call.
isOpenTWAP is forwarded to the external ICP.init call.
initCrowdPooling pushes cpAddress into _REGISTRY_.
initCrowdPooling pushes cpAddress into _USER_REGISTRY_.
creator is used as the key of _USER_REGISTRY_.
baseToken is used as the first key of _REGISTRY_.
quoteToken is used as the second key of _REGISTRY_.
valueCheck compares timeLine[3] against _FREEZE_DURATION_.
valueCheck compares timeLine[2] against _CALM_DURATION_.
valueCheck compares timeLine[4] against _VEST_DURATION_.
valueCheck compares valueList[3] against _CLIFF_RATE_ and valueList[0] is mutated with uint112(-1).
createCrowdPooling reads the immutable _CLONE_FACTORY_ address.
createCrowdPooling reads _CP_TEMPLATE_ as the clone prototype.
_CP_TEMPLATE_ flows into the clone factory external call.
prototype is converted and embedded in the assembly-created bytecode.
prototype is cast to bytes20 targetBytes.
targetBytes is mstored into the assembled clone bytecode.
the assembled bytecode buffer is passed to assembly create.
the created proxy address is returned from clone.
updateCPTemplate overwrites _CP_TEMPLATE_.
_newCPTemplate is assigned into _CP_TEMPLATE_.
setFreezeDuration overwrites _FREEZE_DURATION_.
_newFreeDuration is assigned into _FREEZE_DURATION_.
setCalmDuration overwrites _CALM_DURATION_.
_newCalmDuration is assigned into _CALM_DURATION_.
setVestDuration overwrites _VEST_DURATION_.
_newVestDuration is assigned into _VEST_DURATION_.
setCliffRate overwrites _CLIFF_RATE_.
_newCliffRate is assigned into _CLIFF_RATE_ after the 1e18 bound check.
getCrowdPooling reads _REGISTRY_ for the given pair.
getCrowdPoolingBidirection reads _REGISTRY_ in both token orderings.
getCrowdPoolingByUser reads _USER_REGISTRY_ for the user.
initCrowdPooling invokes the external ICP.init call during execution.
createCrowdPooling invokes the external clone factory call.
the clone factory entry point executes CloneFactory.clone.
CloneFactory.clone reaches the assembly create operation.
updateCPTemplate reaches the owner-only privileged state change path.
setFreezeDuration reaches the owner-only privileged state change path.
setCalmDuration reaches the owner-only privileged state change path.
setVestDuration reaches the owner-only privileged state change path.
setCliffRate reaches the owner-only privileged state change path.
The external ICP.init call targets a caller-supplied cpAddress and executes before _REGISTRY_/_USER_REGISTRY_ are updated, allowing re-entrant factory state manipulation.
